description: Infernal spellbinder who turns ritual flame into fast, escalating battlefield pressure.

presentation.headline: Cinder spellbinder who keeps ritual fire moving through the hunt.
presentation.fantasy_hook: A crooked witch hood, ember-red braid, floating candles, and a sigil wand make her flamecraft instantly readable.
presentation.identity_summary: The Cinder Witch blends hellfire relics with ritual tools, spreading stronger flame through crowded enemy groups instead of relying on direct kill spikes.
presentation.passive_summary: Her hellfire burns hit harder and become more likely to spread farther across nearby enemies as the battlefield grows crowded.
tradeoffs: Spread loses value against isolated targets
